💡 cronmaster | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a centralized, user-friendly web interface for managing and monitoring cron jobs and associated scripts, simplifying task scheduling and execution logging.
✨ Key Features: • Modern UI with dark/light mode • System Information display (uptime, memory, CPU, etc.) • Cron Job Management (view, create, delete) • Script Management (view, create, delete bash scripts) • Job Execution Logging with stdout, stderr, exit codes, and timestamps
📖 Summary: Cronmaster is a TypeScript-based web UI for managing cron jobs. It offers a user-friendly interface for creating, viewing, and deleting cron jobs and associated bash scripts, with features like live logging, log history, and system information display.
